license_required.quote: No person may engage in the practice of medicine in this state without a current license issued by the board.

issuing_authority.quote: The governor shall appoint a North Dakota board of medicine

name.quote: The governor shall appoint a North Dakota board of medicine consisting of fifteen members

type.quote: The governor shall appoint a North Dakota board of medicine consisting of fifteen members; ten physicians, nine of whom are doctors of medicine and one of whom is a doctor of osteopathy; two physician assistants; one naturopath; and two public members.

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from approved school
degree_required.quote: An applicant who is a graduate of an approved medical or osteopathic school located in the United States, its possessions, territories, or Canada, shall present evidence, satisfactory to the board, that the applicant has been awarded a degree of doctor of medicine or doctor of osteopathy from a medical school located in the United States, its possessions, territories, or Canada, approved by the board or by an accrediting body approved by the board at the time the degree was conferred.

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved or accrediting body approved by the board
accrediting_body.quote: approved by the board or by an accrediting body approved by the board at the time the degree was conferred

required.quote: An applicant who is a graduate of an approved medical or osteopathic school located in the United States, its possessions, territories, or Canada, must present evidence, satisfactory to the board, that the applicant has successfully completed one year of postgraduate training in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the board or by an accrediting body approved by the board.

duration.value: One year for US/Canadian graduates; 24 months for international graduates
duration.quote: one year of postgraduate training in the United States or Canada

kind.quote: postgraduate training in a program approved by the board

exams.name: Medical licensure examination
exams.quote: Successful completion of a medical licensure examination satisfactory to the board

required.quote: The board shall promote a high degree of competence in the practice of medicine by establishing rules requiring every physician licensed in the state to fulfill continuing education requirements.

exists.quote: The governor shall appoint a North Dakota board of medicine consisting of fifteen members; ten physicians, nine of whom are doctors of medicine and one of whom is a doctor of osteopathy; two physician assistants; one naturopath; and two public members.

national_association.value: American Board of Medical Specialties, American Osteopathic Association, Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada
national_association.quote: The board may accept current certification, maintenance of certification, or recertification by a member of the American board of medical specialties, the American osteopathic association, or the royal college of physician and surgeons of Canada in lieu of compliance with continuing education requirements.

regulatory_model.quote: No person may engage in the practice of medicine in this state without a current license issued by the board.

credential_type.quote: No person may engage in the practice of medicine in this state without a current license issued by the board.

is_mandatory.quote: No person may engage in the practice of medicine in this state without a current license issued by the board.

title_protection.quote: An individual not licensed as a physician or resident physician under this chapter is prohibited from using the title of "doctor of medicine", "medical doctor", "doctor of osteopathic medicine", "osteopathic physician", "physician", "M.D.", or "D.O.".

scope_protection.quote: No person may engage in the practice of medicine in this state without a current license issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, fraudulent, or forged statement or document in connection with licensing requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any false, fraudulent, or forged statement or document, or the use of any fraudulent, deceitful, dishonest, or immoral practice, in connection with any of the licensing requirements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false or misleading statements about physician's skill or efficacy of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The making of false or misleading statements about the physician's skill or the efficacy of any medicine, treatment, or remedy.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of misdemeanor with direct bearing on ability to practice or any felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction of any misdemeanor determined by the board to have a direct bearing upon a person's ability to serve the public as a practitioner of medicine or any felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of alcohol or drugs to degree that interferes with ability to safely practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of alcohol or drugs to such a degree as to interfere with the licensee's ability to safely practice medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical or mental disability materially affecting ability to perform duties competently
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical or mental disability materially affecting the ability to perform the duties of a physician in a competent manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The performance of any dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining any fee by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting practice of medicine by unlicensed, incompetent, or impaired person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by an unlicensed, incompetent, or impaired person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of medical practice act or board rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of any provision of a medical practice act or the rules and regulations of the board, or any action, stipulation, condition, or agreement imposed by the board or its investigative panels.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of medicine under false or assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of medicine under a false or assumed name.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising for practice of medicine in untrue or deceptive manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The advertising for the practice of medicine in an untrue or deceptive manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representation to patient that manifestly incurable condition can be cured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The representation to a patient that a manifestly incurable condition, sickness, disease, or injury can be cured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or negligent violation of physician-patient confidentiality
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The willful or negligent violation of the confidentiality between physician and patient, except as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of doctor of osteopathy to designate school of practice in professional name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure of a doctor of osteopathy to designate that person's school of practice in the professional use of that person's name by such terms as "osteopathic physician and surgeon", "doctor of osteopathy", "D.O.", or similar terms.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence in the practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sexual abuse, misconduct, or exploitation related to practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sexual abuse, misconduct, or exploitation related to the licensee's practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescription, sale, administration, distribution, or gift of controlled substance for non-therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The prescription, sale, administration, distribution, or gift of any drug legally classified as a controlled substance or as an addictive or dangerous drug for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Payment or receipt of fee, commission, rebate, or compensation for services not rendered or for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The payment or receipt, directly or indirectly, of any fee, commission, rebate, or other compensation for medical services not actually or personally rendered, or for patient referrals

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with reporting requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to comply with the reporting requirements of section 43-17.1-05.1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to transfer medical records or supply copies to patient or representative
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to transfer medical records to another physician or to supply copies of those records to the patient or to the patient's representative when requested to do so by the patient or the patient's designated representative, except if the disclosure is otherwise limited or prohibited by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continued pattern of inappropriate care including unnecessary surgery
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A continued pattern of inappropriate care as a physician, including unnecessary surgery.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, fraudulent, or deceptive statement in document connected with practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any false, fraudulent, or deceptive statement in any document connected with the practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, or giving controlled substance to self or family
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, or giving to oneself or to one's spouse or child any drug legally classified as a controlled substance or recognized as an addictive or dangerous drug.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of state or federal statute or regulation relating to controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of any state or federal statute or regulation relating to controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Imposition of disciplinary action by another state or jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The imposition by another state or jurisdiction of disciplinary action against a license or other authorization to practice medicine based upon acts or conduct by the physician that would constitute grounds for disciplinary action as set forth in this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Lack of appropriate documentation in medical records for diagnosis, testing, and treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The lack of appropriate documentation in medical records for diagnosis, testing, and treatment of patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish board or investigative panel with legally requested information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to furnish the board or the investigative panel, their investigators, or representatives information legally requested by the board or the investigative panel.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Noncompliance with physician health program
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Noncompliance with the physician health program established under chapter 43-17.3.

definition_quote.value: The practice of medicine includes the practice of medicine, surgery, and obstetrics. The following persons are regarded as practicing medicine: (a) A person that holds out to the public as being engaged within this state in the diagnosis or treatment of diseases or injuries of human beings. (b) A person that suggests, recommends, or prescribes any form of treatment for the intended relief or cure of any physical or mental ailment of any individual, with the intention of receiving, directly or indirectly, any fee, gift, or compensation. (c) A person that maintains an office for the examination or treatment of individuals afflicted with disease or injury of the body or mind. (d) A person that attaches the title M.D., surgeon, doctor, D.O., osteopathic physician and surgeon, or any other similar word or words or abbreviation to the person's name, indicating that the person is engaged in the treatment or diagnosis of the diseases or injuries of human beings shall be held to be engaged in the practice of medicine.
definition_quote.quote:
"Practice of medicine" includes the practice of medicine, surgery, and obstetrics. The
following persons are regarded as practicing medicine:
a. A person that holds out to the public as being engaged within this state in the
diagnosis or treatment of diseases or injuries of human beings.
b. A person that suggests, recommends, or prescribes any form of treatment for the
intended relief or cure of any physical or mental ailment of any individual, with the
intention of receiving, directly or indirectly, any fee, gift, or compensation.
c. A person that maintains an office for the examination or treatment of individuals
afflicted with disease or injury of the body or mind.
d. A person that attaches the title M.D., surgeon, doctor, D.O., osteopathic physician
and surgeon, or any other similar word or words or abbreviation to the person's
name, indicating that the person is engaged in the treatment or diagnosis of the
diseases or injuries of human beings shall be held to be engaged in the practice
of medicine.

methods_authorized.quote: "Practice of medicine" includes the practice of medicine, surgery, and obstetrics.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must present evidence of degree, 24 months of postgraduate training in US/Canada, ECFMG certificate, and English language proficiency. Board has discretion to accept alternative qualifications.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: An applicant who is a graduate of a medical school not located in the United States, its possessions, territories, or Canada, shall present evidence, satisfactory to the board, that the applicant possesses the degree of doctor of medicine or a board-approved equivalent based on satisfactory completion of educational programs acceptable to the board. Graduates of osteopathic schools located outside the United States are not eligible for licensure.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: An applicant who is a graduate of an approved medical or osteopathic school located in the United States, its possessions, territories, or Canada, must present evidence, satisfactory to the board, that the applicant has successfully completed one year of postgraduate training in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the board or by an accrediting body approved by the board.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as FDA-approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to patient in hospital or long-term care facility
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as a federal food and drug administration approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to a patient in a hospital or long-term care facility. Opioids may not be prescribed through a telemedicine encounter for any other purpose.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: A licensee who, pursuant to this chapter, prescribes a controlled substance, as defined by North Dakota law, shall comply with all state and federal laws regarding the prescribing of a controlled substance, and shall participate in the North Dakota prescription drug monitoring program.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Licensee must perform telemedicine examination or evaluation meeting requirements before prescribing medications. Opioids limited to FDA-approved medication assisted treatment or hospital/long-term care patients.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A licensee who has performed a telemedicine examination or evaluation meeting the requirements of this chapter may prescribe medications according to the licensee's professional discretion and judgment. Opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as a federal food and drug administration approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to a patient in a hospital or long-term care facility.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: Fees levied under subsection 1 of article XIII of the interstate medical licensure compact by the interstate medical licensure compact commission to the state of North Dakota must be paid by the board through the board's funding mechanism

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician assistant shall collaborate with, consult with, or refer to the appropriate member of the health care team as indicated by the condition of the patient, the education, experience, and competence of the physician assistant, and the standard of care. The degree of collaboration must be determined at the practice which may include decisions made by the employer, group, hospital service, and the credentialing and privileging systems of a licensed facility.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe and dispense schedule II through V substances and all legend drugs, subject to DEA registration and state/federal law compliance
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote:
May prescribe and dispense schedule II through V substances as designated by the federal drug enforcement agency and all legend drugs;
 d. May not dispense a drug, unless pharmacy services are not reasonably available,
dispensing is in the best interest of the patient, or an emergency exists;
 e. May request, receive, and sign for a professional sample, and may distribute a
professional sample to a patient; and
 f. If prescribing or dispensing a controlled substance, shall register with the federal
drug enforcement administration and shall comply with appropriate state and
federal laws.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: Establish a mechanism for dealing with a licensee who abuses or is dependent upon or addicted to alcohol or other addictive chemical substances, to enter an agreement, at its discretion, with a professional organization whose relevant procedures and techniques it has evaluated and approved for the organization's cooperation or participation.
